readmeHTML:
katifetch-for-android-shell-Magisk-Module

Katifetch is now avaible on Magisk!

Katifetch is on magisk/ksu module where show your android info, like neofetch and fastfetch, but for android, is faster, and is the first neofetch alt on make a fetch for android shell, like, only for the shell of android

For the install, uninstall and update, you have to need

  • Root
  • Magisk or ksu (kernel su)
  • For the terminal use termux with command "su" or for pc "adb shell" and then "su"
  • the zip file

    • 📦 Install

    First open magisk or ksu

    Then open Modules

    On Modules click where say Install from storage

    Click on the zip file ( if don't have the zip file: https://github.com/ximimoments/katifetch-for-android-shell-Magisk-Module/releases/download/Katifetch-for-android-shell-module-1.2/katifetch-magisk.zip )

    Click on OK

    When the module is install is requiered restart for the module make change and install katifetch on android shell (Click on reboot)

    On termux or adb shell you have to put su for enter the android shell, if magisk put you a warning you have to say ok for termux or adb shell can open the shell root of android, and put on the terminal "cd" and "clear" (the cd and clear comamand is not requiered but if you want)

    Put katifetch command and look the magic

    🧼 Uninstall

    First open magisk or ksu

    Then open Modules

    On module click on remove

    When is remove you have to back to home

    On home is requiere to reboot the system to make change

    🔄 Update

    Same thing how to install intruction but you have to install again the .zip

  • Work on anything android, katifetch for android shell work on firmware stock, custom rom, gsi and old and new android version!

    • And enjoy using Katifetch on Android shell with modules!
